contract.invalidInputs: Extra fields, boolean revision, blank/oversized text, stale run and wrong checkpoint are rejected without mutation or inference.
contract.learnerData: JSON string under explicit untrusted-data instructions; not inserted as a privileged role.
contract.legacy: Only explicit assessment_mode=choice accepts legacy answer actions; a request cannot downgrade typed mode.
validatorChecks: Exact schema and unique JSON keys
Exact learner substring for met/contradicted points
No numeric score or extra fields
contract.validatorLimits: Schema, citations and quote checks do not certify semantic entailment of free-form comments, coverage judgments or complete injection resistance. Actual model behavior needs separate checks; no broad accuracy claim follows.
contract.bodyLimitNote: Typed endpoint streams at most16,384 bytes before JSON parsing. The larger3,000,000-byte conversation/image cap is separate.

modelLifecycle.sharedEngine: TrainingAdapter.review bypasses the selector transformation while retaining Adapter contract checks and the same loaded engine.
modelLifecycle.sharedLock: Retained typed worker owns app.state.busy, also used by ordinary conversation.
modelLifecycle.timeout: HTTP wait is shielded. Timeout sets failed state/revision while the worker retains the lock until inference finishes.
modelLifecycle.disconnect: Cancelling HTTP does not cancel/unlock the worker; later polling can receive its valid result.
modelLifecycle.lateCompletion: Timed-out or old-run completion fails context/revision/status checks and cannot commit.
modelLifecycle.duplicates: Same action/body returns pending or cached result without another call; changed payload reuse is rejected.
modelLifecycle.retry: Distinct retry receives429 while worker busy and can succeed after completion; response text is preserved.
modelLifecycle.failure: Invalid/unavailable output is visible failure, not a scripted expected-answer substitution.
modelLifecycle.clock: Checkpoint/review/feedback freeze source time; feedback is tied to the original cutoff.

uiReadOnlyReview.draft: Stored outside InputField and keyed by run/checkpoint, surviving rotation/revision polls.
uiReadOnlyReview.staleCompletion: activeReviewId plus run/checkpoint/phase guards prevent old coroutines altering new busy/error state; resets on context change.
uiReadOnlyReview.presentation: Qualitative point labels and eligible reports; typed debrief shows response count, not a numerical grade.
uiReadOnlyReview.text: Text.supportRichText=false; learner/model strings cannot apply rich-text tags.
uiReadOnlyReview.nativeStatus: Not operated or accepted by this reviewer.
